query: 42-year-old male with pneumonia: among male ICU patients aged 37–47 in their first ICU stay, stratify distinct procedures in the first 48 hours into quintiles and report mean procedure count, mean ICU LOS (days), and hospital mortality by quintile.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.icu_stay_id, pr.procedure_code, pr.procedure_date, pr.procedure_type, q.quintile, COUNT(pr.procedure_code) AS procedure_count, AVG(i.length_of_stay) AS avg_los, SUM(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mortality_count FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id JOIN procedureevents pr ON pr.subject_id = p.subject_id AND pr.hadm_id = i.icu_stay_id JOIN quintiles q ON q.quintile BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND (pr.procedure_date - i.intime) <= 48 AND (pr.procedure_date - i.intime) / 48 <= q.quartile END JOIN (SELECT subject_id, hadm_id, length_of_stay FROM icustays WHERE first_careunit = 'ICU') i ON i.subject_id = p.subject_id AND i.hadm_id = pr.hadm_id JOIN (SELECT subject_id, hadm_id, procedure_code, procedure_date, procedure_type FROM procedureevents WHERE procedure_type = 'Surgery') pr ON pr.subject_id = p.subject_id AND pr.hadm_id = i.hadm_id AND pr.procedure_date BETWEEN i.intime AND i.outtime GROUP BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.icu_stay_id, pr.procedure_code, pr.procedure_date, pr.procedure_type, q.quintile ORDER BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.icu_stay_id, q.quintile, procedure_count NULLS LAST;
